title: The Lost Wallet
text:
On the way home from school, Aisha found a brown wallet on the bus seat. It was thick with notes, and nobody was sitting nearby. For a moment she thought about the sweets she could buy.
Then she remembered what her mother always said: what is not yours must go back to its owner. Aisha carried the wallet to the driver and explained where she had found it.
The next morning, an old man came to her flat with a box of kueh. He shook her hand and thanked her again and again. Aisha smiled. Doing the right thing felt much better than sweets.
